book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu ewow numu tunedyooemakwuse, oe'yoona mease, ka Capernaum mee naneadu-wisoo kodyu petuga.
Soo mu tukwutumadu moohedu wawa'a gi Jew numu, sumuoo ka pumme tummatzidu-matu unu soobedya. Oosoo oo tummatzidu unu tuoeyina, ya'ega'a.
Soo wawa'a gi Jew nana ka Te Pabe'e onow pupaa petugana nakase, mu Jew numu moohedu Te Pabe'e-matoo taya, oo bina ka pumme tummatzidu oo mabesaku tuunguna.
Umu ka Te Pabe'e-baa petugase, mee oo netamma, “U sakwa eka wawa'a nana tummatzi.
Soo wawa'a nana tamme Jew numu unu soobedyana, ka te nanesootuhi nobe te matabuekupu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise umu-no mease ka wawa'a nana nobe tzage'e mu manigase, soo tukwutumadu moohedu tu pupua'amu ka Te Pabe'e-matoo taya mee oo netammana, “Nu sukwe wawa'a. Mu Jew numu numme wakwawa'a nuutumooedu. U sakwa gi ne nobe-kwi egeapana, gi hownne'yoo.
Nu gi maawa'ne'yoona, gi u-matoo mea-wa'ne'yoo. Nu u soo'oedyukute u sukwe yadooahoose, oosoo e tummatzidu besa manekwu.
Nu punno'o ka numu nanemadunagadyina sopedakwadoo. Nu puu ka nu-koobatusoo unnetoosoo manakwe.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka meeoo na'unnedu nakase, mee ka ewow numu netamma, “Yow yise soo nana tubetse tunaka'oedyukudu. Tooe gi tamme Jew numu-matu pana unu tunaka'oedyukute.”
Ka tukwutumadu moohedu pupua'amu ka oo nobe-witoo kodyukase, soo oo tummatzidu mooasoo besa manepu.
Oogow mooo'a soo Te Pabe'e umu tunakatzimodu-no yise ewa'yoo numu punno'o umu-no ka Nain mee naneadu-kwitoo kemmana.
Sumu'yoo tooebetse ka mogo'ne penebe dooa ya'e. Soo oo pea o'nosoo tu kooma ya'ekupu. Ewa'yoo umu oo pea nonopua'amu oo-no mea ka tu tooa oo nomatugugakwuse.
Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu wegease
ka kadoo'oo manidu pea tutuha oo soobedyase mee oo netamma, “Gi yagapana.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka ya'edu tzamahoose, mu oo tzagwuudu yise konno pebu'ahoo. Soo Te Pabe'e ka ya'epu tooebetse'e mee netamma, “Yotsehoo.”
Soo tooebetse katuhoose yadooakooha. Soo Te Pabe'e punowsoo nobe-kwitoo mu taya.
Mu numu o konnopunnedu meeoo nana'unnekooha, “Uune! Esoo togesapa unu pooha-ga'yoo. Soo Te Naa te sootuhina, eka unu pooha-gakoo tu yadooawabe, tamme-matoo tayapu.”
Mu numu yise oo nanatuukwekooha ka Te Pabe'e manipu, o'no yise no'yoona numu ka teepu-koobakwitu ka Te Pabe'e-witu naka, mu numu mana tzatzage'e-witu teepu-ga'yoo tooe.
Mu John pupua'amu ka John tuukwe'e no'oko ka Te Pabe'e mane-kwitu.
Waahoo pumme pupua'amu-matu soo John taya ka Te Pabe'e-matoo. Soo John mee mu netamma, “Mu sakwa ka Jesus tutubenga, ‘U haa'a yow Te Pabe'e, pute soo Te Pabe'e saa'a petukwu?’ ”
Ka oo-baa pepetugase, soo Te Pabe'e no'obatusoo tuoegoedu numu mabesakute: tsoapagoedu, gi tubootabuedu, tooe hownnekoo tooe tuoebu.

Soo Te Pabe'e mu nanekwegea, “Mu sakwa ka John tuukwe ka mu poonnena, mu nakana tuwazoo: ka umu gi tubootabuedu numu tubootabue manese, mu toyomodu numu besa momona, mu gi nakatawagadu numu nakatage mu manese, mu numu uagoedu besa manese, mu tuipu numu namayodase, yise ka mu tutuha manedu numu ka Te Naa besa unnepu mu tuukwe.
Pana mu ka ooosapa e naka'oedyukuna, gi nu-ma nasookwina, mu nasootuhikwu.”
Ka mu John pupua'amu kokodyukase, soo Te Pabe'e ka John-witu mu numu tuukwe'e, “Ka o'nosoo nuga-kobenasoo, ka oona giba-ma umu uga ka John-baa petugayakwe. Soo John gi waha-tamme tusooyugwedu nana.

Soo John gi nanenagadu namasoo'a. Pana umu gi oo-makoo oo-matoo me'a. Mu ka John nakapunnekwuse oo-baa petuga, soo John ka Te Naa yadooawabena. Soo John ka umu o'nosoo Te Naa yadooawabe ooonakwa besa'yoo.
Soo John ka Te Naa poena'ewabe. O'nosoo ka John-witu nabotugu soo Te Naa mee e netamma,

content.text: ‘U-kobenasoo ka teepu-koobatoo nu e poena'ewabe tayakwu, ka mu numu ume petukwu-kwitu oo tunesootabue tuunguna.’

content: Soo John no'oko numu ooonakwa besa'yoo. Pana saa'a no'yoona numu nu-toohatu, ka John ooonakwasoo nasootuhikwu.”
Ka mu numu mu tuma'emukwadu mee nananeadu-no ka Te Pabe'e John besa oo nemadabu'e, umu besa sokwama ka baa-wi pumme oo matzakadyakwe. Umu meeoo, “Soo Te Naa tubetse besa'yoo.”
Pana umu nanesootuhibu numu tunedyooedu gi nanekwahana, ka John baa-wi namatzaka tuunguna, ka Te Naa pumme netamma-kwa'ne.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo, “Nu mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu-kwitu mu tuukwekwu.

Mu mu doodooake-wa'ne gi besa mu pupua'amu-no tuate'a. Mu pupua'amu sumuna mee unakwe, ‘Numme mu tunekwukukwu, mu saa'a nugagonno. Pana mu gi nuka.’ Mu pupua'amu yise mee tuwazoo mu netammakwu, ‘Numme ka suda mu sokwama, mu-no sagwikwu, pana mu gi sagwa'e.’
Soo John ka petuse, gi tuka, gi tuwazoo atsa baa hepe. ‘Soo John numu sukwe poohadu,’ mee mu.
Ka nuka mu-baa petugase, nu tukana, hepe, mu yise e nesootzema mee unnena, ‘Oosoo nana ewa tukana, sukwe baayina, umu tuma'emukwadu pupua'amu-gana.’
Umu sokwamadu numu ka Te Naa unnepu nakasopedakwadoona, ‘Besa'yoo,’ mee unnekwu.”

Soo nana Simon mee naneadu ka umu Pharisee mee nananeadu nanesootuhidu-nagatu, ka Te Pabe'e-nabatoo ba'e, oo tuka tuunguna. Sumu'yoo otuoosoo mogo'ne gi toge tumatugudu sapa tooe ka Te Pabe'e ka Simon nobe-wi'yoona ka mu ewa tukana naka. Soo mogo'ne yise besa kwanadu nakwanana tupe-ma namadabuepu osa-wi nakedadu hanena, ka Te Pabe'e-baa petuhooga. Soo Te Pabe'e o sekedabena tukadape, soo mogo'ne oo pepa wunuhoo petu.

Soo mogo'ne yise yagana, ka oo kuku-koobatoo yaga pasawehoo. Yise meatzedose tu tzopuhu-ma oo mabasakuse, oo kuku mootuhikwuna'e, yise ka besa kwanadu nakwana'a oo kuku-koobatoo totsakwatese oo mawo'nge.

Soo Simon ka mogo'ne yoo ka Te Pabe'e sootu'nagana poonnena oo sootu'adyina meeoo oo soobedya, “Esoo Jesus tookwa gi ka Te Naa pooha hee-ga'yoo. Masoo sakwa ka Te Naa pooha uga hee-gana soo oo pooha oo sopedakwadookwu, ka mogo'ne suta'yoona, o'no masoo sakwa uga gi ka mogo'ne natzamakupana.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka Simon soonammena pooha sopedakwadoo, meeoo yise oo netamma, “Nu besasoo u tuukwekwu.” Soo Simon yise ka Te Pabe'e mee netamma, “Ha'yoo u e tuukwekwu?”
Soo Te Pabe'e oo nanekwegease meeoo, “Waha'yoo numu puu ka sumuoo numu nakutzikute. Sumu'yoo ewatse'e oo nakutzikute, sumu'yoo punno'o huutse'e oo nakutzikute.
Umu waha'yoo yise gi hownnekoo oo tumanagakute. Soo mu kutzidu yise mee mu netamma, ‘Nu ka nuka mu nakutzikuna soomu'wakwu.’ Hanotu umu-matu yise unu oo soobedyakwu ka besa pumme oo sootunagase?”
Soo Simon yise ka Te Pabe'e meeoo nanekwegea'a, “Soo ewa oo nakutzikudu, mee tuwa nu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e ka mogo'ne-tamme nakwumunase, ka Simon meeoo netamma, “Nu ka u-baa petuse, u puu gi ka pukwi e tabatsagakwuna e bawununakute. Esoo mogo'ne puu ka e kuku tu yagapu-ma pakedyase yise ka tu tzopuhu-ma a mabasakute.
Esoo mogo'ne puu ka besa nu-matoo soonammese e kuku mootuhikwuna'e, u puu gi e mootuhi ka ha'oo besa nu-matoo soonammena ka e petuse.
Ka besa kwanadu nakwanana e kuku-koobatoo totsakwate e kuku onokoo mawonge u puu yoohoo-ma sapa gi e tzopuhu mahane.

Tooe masoo mogo'ne ewa tuma'emukwakepana, nu yise ka oo tuma'emukwapu soomu'wakwu, masoo ka unu e soobedyana. Nu ka mu numu tuma'emukwadu tuma'emukwana soomu'wa. Susumudu numu ka sagwane tuma'emukwana mee nasooyugwena gi unu e heesoobedya.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka mogo'ne meeoo netamma, “Nu no'oko ume tuma'emukwana soomu'wa.”
“Haga esoo numu tuma'emukwana soomu'wadu mee naneyugwedu?” mee mu numu tuka aatadu nanatubengu.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka mogo'ne meeoo netamma, “U ka nuka naka'oedyukuse u namagwetzoikwu. Besa sapa manena mea.”

footnotes.text: Tupe nakooduadoo oo na'oonnakwi oo nanatzagwona'a soo Te Pabe'e mu wegea.
